description: This PHP class defines an ORM entity representing a country, including its main attributes (country code, name, ISO3 code, numeric code) and getter/setter methods for each property.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: ORM entity class mapping to the 'hs_hr_country' database table with properties for country code, name, ISO3 code, and numeric code, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the country.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the country.

methods.name: getIso3
methods.description: Returns the ISO3 code, if set.

methods.name: getNumCode
methods.description: Returns the numeric code, if set.
